description: Bedarfsgerechte Impuls-Dosierung CO2 im RDWC-Zelt ueber AC Infinity Port 5 (select.rdwc_venti_aktiver_modus_2). Gekuerzt fuer den Test; Stand aus Home Assistant vom 30.09.2026.

conditions.alias: Licht an und geplante Ein-Zeit mindestens co2_start_nach_licht_an vorbei (reconnect-fest)
conditions.value_template: {% set lz = states.binary_sensor.klein_abluft_zustand %}{% set min_an = states('input_number.co2_start_nach_licht_an') | float(15) %}{% set ein = states('time.klein_abluft_geplante_ein_zeit') %}{% if lz is none or lz.state != 'on' %}false{% elif ein not in ['unknown','unavailable','none',''] %}{% set start = today_at(ein[:5]) %}{% if start > now() %}{% set start = start - timedelta(days=1) %}{% endif %}{{ now() >= start + timedelta(minutes=min_an) }}{% else %}{{ (as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(lz.last_changed)) / 60 >= min_an }}{% endif %}

{% set aus = states('time.klein_abluft_geplante_aus_zeit') %}{% set vor = states('input_number.co2_ende_vor_licht_aus') | float(30) %}{% if aus in ['unknown','unavailable',none] %}{{ now() < today_at('16:30') }}{% else %}{{ now() < today_at(aus[:5]) - timedelta(minutes=vor) }}{% endif %}

data.value: {{ [states('input_number.co2_flasche_rest') | float(0) - impuls | float * states('input_number.co2_gramm_pro_sekunde') | float(0.26) / 1000, 0] | max | round(4) }}

variables.gps_mess: {{ (((states('sensor.big_co2_light_sensor_co2') | float(0)) - (co2_vor | float(0))) * states('input_number.co2_zeltvolumen') | float(5.76) / 557 / (impuls | float(5))) | round(4) }}

conditions.value_template: {% set aus = states('time.klein_abluft_geplante_aus_zeit') %}{% set vor = states('input_number.co2_ende_vor_licht_aus') | float(30) %}{% if aus in ['unknown','unavailable',none] %}{{ now() < today_at('16:30') }}{% else %}{{ now() < today_at(aus[:5]) - timedelta(minutes=vor) }}{% endif %}
